alert.title: Users being logged out en masse; session lookups failing overnight
alert.symptoms: Auth-service session reads and writes are failing and users are getting signed out; the session Redis instance is at its memory ceiling. This is not Monday morning and no deploy went out.
alert.error_message: OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory' (session-store)

response.root_cause: Redis session-store hit its maxmemory limit causing OOM errors, preventing session reads/writes.
response.blast_radius: All users of auth-service lose sessions; any downstream services relying on session data are affected, resulting in mass logout.
first_actions: Inspect Redis memory usage and key count via INFO and SCAN
Temporarily increase maxmemory or add eviction policy to free space
If needed, restart the Redis instance or flush expired keys to restore session operations

New alert: Users being logged out en masse; session lookups failing overnight. Service: auth-service, severity: SEV1.
Symptoms: Auth-service session reads and writes are failing and users are getting signed out; the session Redis instance is at its memory ceiling. This is not Monday morning and no deploy went out.
Error: OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory' (session-store)

Evidence (only these incidents may be cited):
Incident INC-019 (auth-service, SEV1, 2026-08-11T04:22:37Z):
Symptoms: Users logged out en masse; auth-service session lookups failing with Redis OOM errors starting 04:22 UTC (not a Monday).
Root cause: 'Remember me' sessions were issued with no TTL cap (some over a year old); accumulated session keys filled the auth-service session Redis instance to its 1GB maxmemory limit.
Resolver: Ananya Iyer

Incident INC-003 (order-worker, SEV2, 2026-05-18T07:05:41Z):
Symptoms: order-worker job processing stalled Monday morning; Redis returning OOM errors, queue depth past 41k, order confirmation emails delayed.
Root cause: Weekend order volume queued jobs and cached idempotency keys in Redis without eviction; by Monday's traffic ramp Redis hit its 2GB maxmemory limit with the default noeviction policy.
Resolver: Ananya Iyer

Incident INC-008 (order-worker, SEV2, 2026-06-15T06:58:12Z):
Symptoms: Second Monday-morning Redis OOM in a month; order-worker queue depth past 38k again, same signature as INC-003.
Root cause: The allkeys-lru eviction policy set after INC-003 slowed the OOM but idempotency keys from the order-retry-queue still have no TTL, so memory pressure builds back up over the weekend.
Resolver: Ananya Iyer

Ranked fixes (use the top one as first_actions[0]):
  1. flush_expired_and_stale_sessions (score=+0.667, worked=1, partial=0, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
  2. set_explicit_session_ttl_cap (score=+0.500, worked=0, partial=1, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
Recurrence: This is occurrence #2 of this pattern.
Team expert: Ananya Iyer (Resolved 1 incident matching this pattern with a working fix.)
